csv_project_name: AE Services for Nursing / Allied Health Building Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The project will renovate the two-story building to create specialized laboratories for nursing, biology, general classrooms and selected administrative and support office spaces will be developed. The building will be reduced to its exterior framework and load-bearing structural elements, allowing for a comprehensive renovation of all major building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, life safety, and IT infrastructure.

title: AE Services for Nursing / Allied Health Building Renovation
short_description: Renovation of a two-story college building into nursing and allied health laboratories.
project_scope: Comprehensive renovation of a two-story building for Williamsburg Technical College. The building will be stripped back to its exterior framework and load-bearing structural elements and converted to include specialized laboratories for nursing and biology, general classrooms, and selected administrative and support office spaces. Major building systems to be fully renewed include HVAC, electrical, plumbing, life safety, and IT infrastructure.
services: AE services; all disciplines requested for building renovation planning and design.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project with substantial renovation scope and structural implications.
- Educational/laboratory use adds some technical complexity.
- However, it is a conventional college building renovation rather than a long-span, bridge, roof, stadium, or special lightweight structure.
- Strong MEP/system renewal component, which is less central to sbp's core profile.
- Potential relevance mainly as a building structure collaboration opportunity, but not a top-priority fit.
